final_answer:
Added `LazyFile.is_open` as a boolean property returning `self._f is not None` without calling `open()`.

Only `src/click/utils.py` changed; no untracked files remain.

arguments.command:
@'
import io
import sys
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from click.utils import LazyFile
f = LazyFile('unused', mode='w')
with patch.object(LazyFile, 'open', side_effect=AssertionError('unexpected open')):
    assert f.is_open is False
    f._f = io.StringIO()
    assert f.is_open is True
    f.close()
    assert f.is_open is True
assert isinstance(LazyFile.is_open, property)
'@ | python -B - && git --no-pager diff --check && git --no-pager diff --stat && git --no-pager status --short
arguments.description: Verify property behavior and only requested file changed

import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/click/utils.py')
original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:src/click/utils.py'])
marker = b'    def open(self) -> t.IO[t.Any]:'
pos = original.index(marker)
addition = b'    @property\n    def is_open(self) -> bool:\n        return self._f is not None\n\n'
p.write_bytes(original[:pos] + addition + original[pos:])
'@ | python -B -; git --no-pager diff --check && git --no-pager diff --stat && git --no-pager status --short
